text_block_list.text:
When I visited the waiting room before the 
race, Silence Suzuka was nowhere to be 
seen.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
My legs were itching to run. So around the 
venue...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Only looking at the very front... running 
with everything I have to the end.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I won't surrender the view from the front 
to anyone.
